text:
Varnholt Logistics has appointed Dorian Feltz as its chief executive, the company announced on 12 March. He takes up the post on 1 April.

The decision was made at an extraordinary board meeting held on 11 March, according to the company's formal press release, which this newspaper has reviewed.

Margit Osterlund, chair of the Varnholt Logistics board, confirmed the appointment and said Feltz was chosen after a seven-month search.

Feltz will oversee a workforce of 4,300 employees across 11 distribution hubs.

The press release set out the timing of the appointment and the board's process but did not elaborate on the terms of Feltz's contract. Varnholt Logistics has not announced any other changes to its senior management arising from the decision.
